facts.fact: UNDP Malawi reports that the NRB-built Digitally Signed Biometric QR Verification platform, using QR codes generated from NRIS plus biometrics, verifies farmers online and offline for the Farm Input Subsidy Programme.
facts.system: Digitally Signed Biometric QR Verification for Secure Farmer Social Protection Programme (Offline Digital ID)

facts.fact: UNDP Malawi reports the platform authenticated more than 1.2 million farmers nationwide under the Farm Input Subsidy Programme; the date of the verifications is not given, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Digitally Signed Biometric QR Verification for Secure Farmer Social Protection Programme (Offline Digital ID)
